rule: For each colour c, find each 4-connected group of 3..40 non-c cells whose in-grid 4-neighbours are all c and which has exactly one cell on the grid border. Add every c-component of at most 10 cells that lies off the border and whose 4-neighbours are all in the group (pockets). Repaint the group and its pockets in the colour of the single border cell. All other cells are unchanged.

authored_scope: Supported: dense noise grids 12..30 per side by default, or explicit 8..30 (non-square allowed); 1..4 real edge cracks; 0..4 distractor blocks within a budget of h*w//50 blocks. One shared block-size sampler and one shared crack-shape sampler (same straight-shaft branch, same targets 3 / 3..16 / 17..40) serve real, near, leak, double, inner and over40 cracks. Each negative differs from a real crack only by a semantic edit: dropped border cell, second border shaft, rim breach into noise, free-standing block, 2-cell notch, or growth to 41..48 cells. All crack kinds get pockets at the same rate (1..10 cells filled; 11..12 are threshold controls that stay c). All blocks get optional 1..2-cell enclosed impurities and ragged rim runs. Fixtures are replayed through explicit base noise plus latent crack geometry. Deliberately not supported: pockets enclosed only 4-wise (4/8 ambiguous), a crack border cell on a grid corner, multiple pockets per crack, non-rectangular pockets other than a trimmed 2x6, and c-regions bounded partly by impurities next to a crack.
authored_constraints: Blocks are axis-aligned rectangles at least one cell apart; blocks within two cells of each other have different colours.
Every crack cell except the border cell (0,k), and the added double/leak paths, lies strictly inside its block. k is never at a block end, so no crack touches a grid corner.
All block-colour holes are absorbed into the crack, so the only enclosed block-colour region is a planned pocket, which is fully 8-ringed by crack cells.
Real cracks have 3..40 cells; over40 controls have more than 40 cells and exactly one border cell; notches have exactly 2 cells with distinct colours.
Impurities and ragged rim cells have no 8-contact with crack, pocket or path cells. Impurities never touch the rim and ragged runs never touch impurities.
Crack colours differ from the block colour, and each crack contains a colour other than its border colour, so every real fill changes the grid.
A scene is accepted only if the qualifying (crack, pocket) set under both 4- and 8-connectivity equals the planned real cracks exactly. The output is painted from latent geometry only.
num_cracks + num_distractors <= max(1, h*w//50); an explicit over40 requires a grid with a 10x10 edge slot.
